title: Quality Gnomes!
text: Quality Gnomes!. These are quality gnomes! I have lots of themed gnomes for my tiered tray and this pair is one of the nicer ones. The features look well thought out and not just slapped together. The gnomes are weighted so they don't topple over. There hats can be shaped. Overall, very nice gnomes.
